_doc: The INSTALL ontology's one-sided observer declarations, measured 2026-08-02. DATA, not a fixture the engine reads: this file exists so the gate can pin what an installation happens to declare WITHOUT the test source naming install tipos (scripts/lib/tld_census.ts counts a tipo token in a *.test.ts as a binding; test/**/fixtures/ is data and excluded). The gate tolerates ABSENCE — a database carrying none of this ontology is not a failure, it is a different installation — but it refuses a declaration that is PRESENT and unpinned, which is the drift this census exists to catch.
